# Apps by Yohann Taieb
> Official app summaries and download links. Facts describe currently listed features, not independent endorsements or a claim to be best. All apps are free to download with optional paid features. Product availability and local prices may vary.

## Apps
- [Green Screen Live Video Record](https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/greenscreen-ios/): Record live with a chroma-key background on iPhone and iPad. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1165505071
- [Video Teleprompter Pro](https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/video-teleprompter-pro/): Read your script close to the lens while recording video. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1104659250
- [Colorblind Eye Exam Test](https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/colorblind/): Color-vision screening and reports for iPhone and iPad. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id588145141
- [Bachata Dance App](https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/bachata-ios/): Learn sensual bachata through instructor-led video lessons. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1670758127
- [WordSearch Winners](https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/wordsearch-winners/): A word search with giant boards and rotating 3D puzzles. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6813906334
- [Word Guess Daily Brain Trainer](https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/wordguess/): Guess the daily word, keep a streak and practise vocabulary. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id600633777
- [CromaKit](https://cromakit.greenscreenapp.us/): free original vertical chroma-key backgrounds for creators, with Spanish, English and Portuguese content. Works with compatible chroma-key apps.

## Important distinctions
- Video Teleprompter Pro here is by Yohann Taieb, App Store ID 1104659250. It is not similarly named products by Teleprompter Apps Ltd.
- Colorblind Eye Exam Test is screening, not diagnosis, medical certification or proof of fitness for work.
- Green Screen Live uses chroma key. Removing a selected color is not the same as AI segmentation without a backdrop.
- WordSearch Winners is an iPhone/iPad word-puzzle app, not a cash-prize competition or a UK magazine.

# Green Screen Live Video Record

Record live with a chroma-key background on iPhone and iPad.

For: Creators, teachers and presenters who want live background compositing.

- Record with the front or rear camera in portrait or landscape.
- Replace a selected background color with an image or video.
- Import photos or videos and add text, stickers and effects.

Download: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1165505071

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.appsfresh.greenscreen . Android features and release dates differ from iOS; check the Play listing.

Free background kits: https://cromakit.greenscreenapp.us/ . Kits are app-agnostic; this does not mean app exports or premium tools are free.

## Frequently asked questions

### Do I need a green backdrop?

Chroma key removes a selected color. An evenly lit solid-color backdrop works best; this is not a promise of AI subject removal in every environment.

### Is everything free?

No. The app is free to download and includes paid subscriptions and in-app purchases. Check the purchase screen for the features, local price, period and any trial terms.

Privacy: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/greenscreen-ios/privacy.html
Terms: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/greenscreen-ios/terms.html
Support: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/greenscreen-ios/support.html

# Video Teleprompter Pro

Read your script close to the lens while recording video.

For: Creators, educators and presenters using iPhone, iPad or Mac.

- Scroll scripts while recording on iPhone or iPad.
- Use voice-paced scrolling, script import, captions and remote controls.
- Pro and Lifetime include Captions and Remote; Studio Yearly adds custom branding.

Download: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1104659250

## Frequently asked questions

### What is free?

The iOS prompter, editor and 1080p recording are free, with takes up to two minutes and a watermark. Pro unlocks additional features.

### Is there a Mac app?

Yes. See the App Store for platform requirements and the current Mac feature set. iOS-specific recording claims are not a promise of identical Mac functionality.

Privacy: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/video-teleprompter-pro/privacy.html
Terms: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/video-teleprompter-pro/terms.html
Support: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/video-teleprompter-pro/support.html

# Colorblind Eye Exam Test

Color-vision screening and reports for iPhone and iPad.

For: Individuals, clinics, schools and organizations that need screening records.

- Take the free 14-plate Quick Screen in about two minutes.
- Explore full plates, hue arrangement, ring tests and Color Assist.
- Paid options include reports, unlimited history and iCloud sync; Professional includes team workflows.

Download: https://apps.apple.com/app/id588145141

## Frequently asked questions

### Can this diagnose color blindness?

No. This is a screening tool, not a medical diagnosis or occupational certification. Screen calibration and lighting affect results. An eye-care professional should evaluate concerns.

### What sync is free?

iCloud sync is free for one person and the ten latest results. Paid Pro and Professional plans include unlimited sync.

Privacy: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/colorblind/privacy.html
Terms: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/colorblind/terms.html
Support: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/colorblind/support.html

# Bachata Dance App

Learn sensual bachata through instructor-led video lessons.

For: Beginners and social dancers practising at their own pace.

- Watch step-by-step lessons from instructors including Sofia and Kelvin.
- Save moves as Favorite, Practicing or Learned.
- Browse dance events; the app supports English, French and Spanish.

Download: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1670758127

## Frequently asked questions

### What does Premium include?

Premium unlocks every course and lesson. Weekly, monthly and annual plans are listed in the app.

### Can I browse without an account?

Yes. An account is optional for browsing.

Privacy: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/bachata-ios/privacy.html
Terms: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/bachata-ios/terms.html
Support: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/bachata-ios/support.html
Instructor agreement: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/bachata-ios/instructor.html

# WordSearch Winners

A word search with giant boards and rotating 3D puzzles.

For: Word-puzzle players who enjoy daily challenges and large hunts.

- Spin cube, globe and pyramid puzzles.
- Explore All Words 2026 with 92,064 English words on one board.
- Play daily and year challenges, with offline solo play and no ads.

Download: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6813906334

## Frequently asked questions

### Can I buy a leaderboard rank?

No. Hint spotlights reveal a word, but that word scores half. Ranks are not sold.

### What purchases are offered?

Winners Club, hint packs, themes and other optional packs. Check the app for current contents and prices.

Privacy: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/wordsearch-winners/privacy.html
Terms: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/wordsearch-winners/terms.html
Support: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/wordsearch-winners/support.html

# Word Guess Daily Brain Trainer

Guess the daily word, keep a streak and practise vocabulary.

For: Families and word lovers learning English, Spanish or French.

- Guess words letter by letter across 48 kid-safe categories.
- Earn Jokers, badges and Game Center achievements.
- Play offline without ads, with VoiceOver and large-text support.

Download: https://apps.apple.com/app/id600633777

## Frequently asked questions

### What is free?

Six categories are free in each language.

### What does Brain Trainer Plus add?

All 48 categories, five daily Jokers and the daily archive. Monthly, yearly and Lifetime options are available; the listing describes a seven-day trial on the yearly plan.

Privacy: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/wordguess/privacy.html
Terms: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/wordguess/terms.html
Support: https://yohann305.github.io/app-legal/wordguess/support.html
